subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should Control UI support hard-refresh/bookmarked legacy or arbitrary deep routes for public assets, or should only root, known routes, and configured basePath mounts be supported?
rationale: Current main already covers normal root and configured-basePath assets, but the remaining `/connections/...` or arbitrary deep-route behavior changes the supported URL contract and interacts with intentional static-asset 404 behavior.

options.title: Define the route contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose whether deep legacy/non-tab paths should redirect, serve assets, or remain unsupported before accepting another fix.

options.title: Treat deep legacy paths as unsupported
options.body: Close the remaining edge after documenting that users should enter through root, known app routes, or configured `gateway.controlUi.basePath` mounts.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow deep-route repair
options.body: Ask for a fresh same-repo PR with browser proof that supports the chosen deep-route behavior without weakening the static-asset 404 contract.

recommendation.title: Define the route contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose whether deep legacy/non-tab paths should redirect, serve assets, or remain unsupported before accepting another fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history across the gateway static-serving path and current UI snapshot touched by this product-boundary decision.
